GraceDeployment.Target: A local Go executable built from ./cmd/cli, running in an interactive terminal with a writable operating-system user configuration directory.
GraceDeployment.Notes: Deployment applies to local executable distribution; no hosted service or release pipeline is configured. SQLite migrations are embedded from migrations/sqlite and applied on database open. The database uses foreign keys, WAL mode, a 5000 ms busy timeout, and a single open connection. Supported release platforms, packaging, and rollback procedures are not yet specified.
